description: Discord thread management. Actions: create (from message or standalone), archive, unarchive, lock, delete.

action.description: Action: create, archive, unarchive, lock, delete.

auto_archive.description: Auto-archive duration in minutes: 60, 1440, 4320, or 10080 (create only).

channel.description: Parent channel name or ID (create only).

guild_id.description: Guild ID for channel name resolution. Defaults to DISCORD_GUILD_ID env var.

message_id.description: Create thread from this message (create only). Omit for standalone thread.

private.description: Create private thread (create only, default false).

name: discord_thread
